cameras.description: Cameras, picked with '--camera name|index' (default the first).

format_version.description: Version of the scene format: 2. Required.

imports.description: Scene files whose materials, mediums, lights, entities and templates join this scene's (paths relative to this file; local ids override imported ones; cycles are refused). 'world', 'cameras', 'render' and 'units' are not imported.

mediums.description: Participating media, bound to entities by 'interior_medium' / 'exterior_medium'.

render.description: How to render the scene; the CLI overrides it.

templates.description: Blueprints: no geometry until an entity of 'type: instance' references one by 'name'. A template's own transform composes under the instance's.

validation.description: Settings of the validation harness ('validation/run.py'); not read by the engine.

scale.description: Frequency multiplier of the height field.

texture.description: Height field; its luminance times 'strength' is a height in scene units.

aperture.description: Lens diameter in scene units (0 = pinhole).

aperture_ratio.description: Aperture width / height (below 1: anamorphic oval bokeh).

aperture_rotation.description: Rotation of the blade polygon, degrees.

ev100.description: Exposure value at ISO 100 (15 sunny day, 7 lit interior), instead of ISO, shutter and f-number.

f_stop.description: f-number: the aperture is the focal length over N.

focal_length.description: Focal length in millimetres: with 'sensor_width' it sets the field of view.

focus_distance.description: Distance of the plane in focus, along the view axis (default 1).

focus_point.description: A point in focus: wins over 'focus_distance'.

iso.description: ISO of the physical exposure (with 'shutter_speed' and 'f_stop').

motion.description: Camera keyframes; the base pose is the key at time 0.

sensor_width.description: Sensor width in millimetres, spanning the image width (default 36).

shutter_interval.description: Motion-blur interval '[open, close]' inside the animation range [0, 1].

white_balance.description: White balance, kelvin: a light of this colour temperature renders neutral.

CameraData.description: A thin-lens camera: a field of view, or the photographic 'focal_length' on a 'sensor_width'; a lens 'aperture' in scene units, or an 'f_stop'.

autobump.description: Add the detail finer than the subdivision as a bump.

blend_with_mask.description: On a mix: blend the two materials' displacements with the mix's blend.

bound.description: Largest displacement, scene units, padding the bounds (0: from 'scale').

midlevel.description: Texture value that means no displacement (default 0).

uv_scale.description: UV multiplier on top of the texture's 'uv_scale'.

DisplacementData.description: Displacement of a mesh: scalar 'v + scale (h − midlevel) n' along the smooth normals, or vector 'v + scale (rgb − midlevel)' in tangent or object space.

displacement_enabled.description: False: this entity skips its material's displacement.

exterior_medium.description: Id of the medium outside, when the loader cannot infer it.

heightmap_path.description: Baked height map (16-bit PNG preferred), relative to the scene.

interior_medium.description: Id of the medium inside the entity (from 'mediums:').

material_overrides.description: Scene material ids for the file's own materials, by name (when 'material' is unset).

matrix.description: A 4×4 matrix, 16 numbers row by row acting on column vectors (translation in the last column); instead of translate / rotate / scale.

motion.description: Motion keyframes; the base transform is the key at time 0.

n0.description: Vertex normals: all three make the triangle smooth.

path.description: Model file ('.obj', '.gltf', '.glb', '.ply'), relative to the scene.

profile.description: lathe: '[r, y]' points; extrusion: closed '[x, z]' polygon.

rotate.description: Euler degrees, applied in 'rotate_order' (default xyz: X first).

seed.description: Seed of the randomised procedural textures (default from the entity's position in the file).

subdivision_pixel_error.description: Adaptive target: subdivide until the longest projected edge is below this many pixels.

EntityData.description: An entity: a primitive, a model file, a CSG, a group or an instance of a template. Every entity takes the same transform ('scale', then 'rotate' in 'rotate_order', then 'translate'; or a 'matrix') and motion keys.

material.description: Material id. Unset: a Lambertian of the sky's 'ground_albedo' (physical skies) or 'ground_color' (gradient), else grey 0.5.

point.description: A point on the plane, or the centre of the quad / disk. Default the origin.

size.description: Half side of the quad, radius of the disk. Default 50.

uv_scale.description: UV tiling '[u, v]' on top of the surface's own UVs.

GroundData.description: The ground: a shorthand for a plane, quad or disk under the scene.

angular_radius.description: Half-angle of the light's disc, degrees (0 = sharp shadows; the sun 0.265).

corner.description: Rectangle: a corner and the two edges 'u', 'v' (it emits on the side of u × v).

direction.description: spot: the axis; directional: towards where the light travels; point: the axis of an IES profile.

ies.description: IES (LM-63) photometric file, relative to the scene: the light emits its candela distribution.

illuminance.description: Illuminance on a surface facing the light, lux (default 1).

inner_angle.description: Half-angle where the spot starts to fall off, degrees (default 15).

luminance.description: Luminance of the emitting surface, nits (default 1).

outer_angle.description: Half-angle of the spot's cone, degrees (default 30).

power.description: Emitted flux in 'power_unit', instead of the quantity above.

soft_radius.description: Floor of the 1/d² term near the light (scene units), for lights in dense media.

temperature.description: Colour temperature in kelvin (black body), multiplying the colour.

visibility.description: Visibility of the light's surface (area, sphere).

LightData.description: A light. Its amount is the photometric quantity of the type, the colour a tint of luminance 1: 'intensity' in candela (point, spot), 'luminance' in nits (area, sphere), 'illuminance' in lux (directional), or 'power' for the finite lights.

blend.description: Share of 'material_b': a number (default 0.5) or a texture mask.

color.description: lambertian: albedo (default 0.5). metal: reflectance at normal incidence (default 1). dielectric: tint of the transmitted light (default 1). emissive: colour of the emission (a texture keeps its values, a colour is a tint of luminance 1).

displacement.description: Displacement of the meshes using the material (on a mix: 'blend_with_mask').

edge_color.description: metal: F82 tint, the colour near grazing incidence (default white).

eta.description: metal: complex IOR, real part per channel (with 'k').

k.description: metal: complex IOR, extinction per channel.

preset.description: metal: measured complex IOR (gold, silver, copper, aluminium, ...), instead of the colours.

roughness.description: metal, dielectric: GGX roughness, α = roughness² (default 0, smooth).

specular_rotation.description: Rotation of the anisotropic highlight around the normal, degrees.

subsurface_radius.description: Mean free path in scene units (default 1), per channel times 'subsurface_radius_scale'.

temperature.description: emissive: colour temperature in kelvin (black body), multiplying the colour.

MaterialData.description: A material. Every colour or scalar input marked as a parameter takes a number, a colour '[r, g, b]' or a texture block.

air_density.description: Air (Rayleigh) density multiplier, 1 = the standard atmosphere.

data.description: Inline densities, nx·ny·nz values in z-major order (as a '.vol' file).

dust_density.description: Mie dust density (0 pristine, 1 clean, above 1 polluted).

file.description: A '.vol' file, relative to the scene.

phase.description: Phase function (default isotropic; atmosphere: of the dust, default hg 0.76).

scale_height.description: Exponential scale height H: the density falls by e every H.

sigma_a.description: Absorption coefficient per channel (height fog: at 'y0'; procedural, grid: at density 1).

w.description: Weight of the forward lobe of 'double_hg'.

y0.description: height_fog: altitude of the reference density; atmosphere: sea level.

MediumData.description: A participating medium: 'world.medium', or an entry of 'mediums:' with an 'id'. Coefficients are per scene unit.

path.description: Tangent-space normal map image, relative to the scene.

camera.description: The camera to render, by name or index.

exposure.description: Exposure in stops, added to the camera's physical exposure.

RenderData.description: How to render the scene. Each key is the CLI flag of the same name ('light_sampling' = '--light-sampling'); a flag given on the command line wins, and a '-q' preset given there wins over the keys it sets. A preset with a '-tiny' / '-small' suffix scales the scene's 'width' × 'height' to a quarter / a half.

background.description: A separate plate shown to camera rays only.

ground_albedo.description: Albedo of the ground below the horizon of a physical sky (default 0.3), and of 'world.ground' when it has no material.

ground_color.description: Below the horizon (gradient), and the albedo of 'world.ground' when it has no material.

path.description: Equirectangular image ('.hdr', '.exr'), relative to the scene.

rotate.description: Rotation of the sky, Euler degrees as an entity's 'rotate'.

turbidity.description: Atmospheric turbidity: 1 pristine, 3 clear (default), 5 haze, 10 smog.

SkyData.description: The environment: what a ray that leaves the scene sees.

StratumData.description: One altitude/slope band of a heightfield: altitude normalised to [0, 1] above 'sea_level', slope in degrees off the horizontal plane.

angular_radius.description: Gradient sky: half-angle of the disc in degrees (default 1.5; the real sun 0.265).

color.description: Tint of the gradient sky's disc (luminance 1).

extract_from_hdri.description: HDRI: extract the brightest peak as an analytic sun.

extract_threshold.description: HDRI: threshold of the extraction, multiple of the mean luminance (default 50).

luminance.description: Gradient sky: luminance of the disc, nits (default 10).

visibility.description: Only 'camera' applies: 'false' hides the disc from camera rays.

SunData.description: The sun of a sky. Gradient sky: a disc of 'luminance' nits. HDRI: a sun extracted from the image. Physical skies: the direction only (the disc follows from the atmosphere).

color_space.description: How the stored values relate to linear light: 'srgb' or 'linear'. Unset: sRGB where the texture is a colour, linear where it is data (roughness, weights, masks, heights).

colors.description: The pattern's colours (two; brick three: brick, alternate brick, mortar).

mode.description: gradient: linear, quadratic, easing, spherical, radial. coordinate: object, uv, generated, world.

noise_strength.description: Amplitude of the turbulence (noise), of the vein distortion (marble), of the grain (wood).

output.description: marble, wood: 'color' or 'mask'; voronoi: the feature it outputs.

path.description: Image file, relative to the scene.

randomize_offset.description: A per-object random offset (from the entity's seed).

rotation.description: Rotation of the pattern space, Euler degrees.

scale.description: Frequency: a number, or '[sx, sy, sz]' to stretch a solid pattern per axis.

TextureData.description: A texture: an image or a procedural pattern.

length.description: Length of one scene unit: metres as a number, or 'm', 'cm', 'mm', 'km', 'in', 'ft'. Default 1 m. Used where a quantity carries metres: the aperture of 'f_stop' (millimetres), candela and power of the lights, the atmosphere.

VisibilityData.description: Per-ray-category visibility: 'false' makes the surface invisible to rays of that category, which go on as if it were not there.

medium.description: The medium filling the scene (fog, atmosphere).
